title: Evidence-gated incident simulation
goal: Restore the local simulated service without making an unsupported intervention.

assumptions: Telemetry comes from the explicitly attached local simulator
risks: A coincidental deployment or high CPU can mislead diagnosis
successCriteria: Independent health check succeeds and wrongActions is zero
unsupported: Production infrastructure and real incident diagnosis

nodes.description: Read measured load and error signals.
Read whether a deployment changed, independently of metrics.
Roll back only the fixture's explicitly diagnosed deployment condition.
Choose the alternative load intervention only with a verified capacity signal.
Join both alternative paths, allowing the unselected branch to be skipped, before checking actual resulting simulator health.
